bibl.note: Scanned edition with foot-of-page variants from a manuscript (siglum ka), 306 pp. (file karnatakadambari-onlytext.pdf). Editor, publisher and date to be filled in. The book's page numbers equal the PDF pages; pages without a printed number are marked type="unprinted".

projectDesc.p: Transliteration is ISO-15919 with ṟ (ಱ) and ḻ (ೞ) kept apart from r and ḷ, and e/o short, ē/ō long. Anusvāra before a stop is written with the nasal of the stop's class (ṅ ñ ṇ n m), as in the other texts of this project; elsewhere ṁ.

The text is not proofread beyond the pages named in the respStmt. Where the two readings of the page images differ, both are kept: app type="ocr" with the first reading as lem (wit="#run1") and the second as rdg (wit="#run2"); a letter one reading marked as doubtful and the other reading confirms is unclear. Lines the editor corrected have neither.

Structure: div type="sandarśana" = a section of the text as headed in the print; lg = a verse (n the number printed, repaired where the print or the readings are wrong: see numbers-report.txt of the workspace; unnumbered stanzas have none); l = a printed line; p = a prose passage, begun in the print by the abbreviation va॥ (label), with lb at the beginning of every printed line (a line break inside a word is not marked as such: the readings do not say).

div.p: va॥adalladeyuṁ

va॥adaṁ kēḷdu majjanakkujjugaṅgeydoḍḍōlaganuṁ paḻiyalvē
ḻdāsthānamaṇṭapadiṁ mahīpālanēḷvudumanēkāṅgadamakarikāpatrādigaḷiṁ
miñcu poṇmi tammoḷ paḷañcaleyeyuṁ tōramuyppugaḷoḷeseva kuṅku
maṅgaḷa bambala sōṅkinoḷ rajaṁ negedu desegaḷ pombaṇṇamāgeseyeyuṁ
tumbigaḷ pūgoḷaṁ biṭṭu mēge negeyeyuṁ karṇōtpalaṅgaḷ kapōla
bimbagaḷoḷ bimbiseyuṁ tōra muttinahāraṅgaḷurasthalaṅgaḷoḷ poḷe
dāḍeyumatisambhramadinoḍanēḷva mahīpālaroḷaṁ aṁsāvasakta camarījevaraśāvaśaktiyarappa camarija

yarappa kānteyara kamaḷa madhupānadiṁ sokkida mattañceya dhvanigaḷante
jarjharamāda poṅgejjegaḷa melluliyoḷaṁ viḷāsinījanada ghanajaghanaṅgaḷoḷ
paḷañcuva ratnamālegaḷoḷamaḍiyiḍuva ramaṇiyara nūpuraraṇitakkeḷasibarpa
añceviṇḍiniñcaradoḷamullasitamāda kāñcīkrēṅkārakkutkaṇṭhaṅgaḷāda sāra
saṅgaḷa kūjitaṅgaḷoḷamanupamaprāsādakūṭakuharaṅgaḷoḷ mūrdani
yiḍuva paḍiyarara kaḷakaḷaṅgaḷoḷarasugaḷimagetamagendu poḍuvaḍuvalli maṇi
kuṭṭimataḷadoḷ paḷañcuva maṇimaya kirīṭa karṇapūra kēyūrahāraraṇi
taṅgaḷoḷameḍavariyadaḍiyiḍuva māmasakakañji maṇikuṭṭimataḷada pūva
liyaṁ biṭṭu pāruva madhuvihaṅgaṅgaḷa huṅkāradoḷaṁ munde bandōduva
maṅgaḷapāṭhakara jayajayādi madhuraravaṅgaḷoḷamatikṣubhitamādāsthānamaṁ
ṭapadiṁ manujēndraṁ poṟamaṭṭu sakaḷarājalōkamaṁ visarjisi caṇḍāla
kanneyaṁ viśramisalvēḻdu vaiśampāyananaṁ mahādēviyararamanege kaḷupi
mendā tāmbūlakaraṅkavāhinige besasi kelabararasumakkaḷverasoḷagupokku

va॥anantaraṁ kaṭṭida beḷuvaṭṭiya mēlkaṭṭinoḷaṁ tīvida cembonna
dōṇigaḷoḷamaḷaṅkarisida paḷukina paṭṭavaṇegaḷoḷaṁ parimaḷakkeṟagi musu
ṟuva maṟidumbiya bambaliṁ nīḷāmbaradiṁ bāsaṇisidantirda gandhōdakakala
śaṅgaḷoḷameseva majjanapradēśakke majjanōpakaraṇasampādanavyagraparijanaṁ
berasu bandu nīrdōṇiyoḷōlāḍi majjanapīṭhamanalaṅkarisidāgaḷ.
antu majjanānantaradoḷ

va॥anantaraṁ sampāditapitr̥tarpaṇanumabhivanditasahasrakiraṇanuma
bhyarcita bhagavadbhavānīvallabhacaraṇakamaḷanumupacaritalēpanāḷaṅkāranumā
cari muccari tābhyavahāranumudgr̥hītatāmbūlakaraṅkavāhinīskandhavinyastahastanu
māgi katipayapadaṅgaḷaṁ naḍedidiroḷ poḷeva paḷukina bhittiyante suttida
nētradukūladoḷaṁ kastūriya kampiniṁ poreda candanadaṇpiṁ kuḷirvamaṇi
kuṭṭimataḷadoḷaṁ gaganataḷadoḷ poḷeva tārāvaḷiyante nīlada nelagaṭṭinoḷ
poreda pūvaliyoḷaṁ gr̥hadēvateyar saṁnidavādarenisi rañjisuva maṇimaya

kambaṅgaḷoḷaṁ mandaisi negevagarudhūpadhūmadoḷamesevāsthānamaṇṭapadoḷ

va॥mattamalli giḷigaḷa gūḍindudirva dāḷimbada bittugaḷinosarva

pallavāḷaṅkr̥tamuṁ sandhyākāladante nr̥tyannīlakaṇṭhamuṁ pallavāruṇitamuṁ
sāmrājyavibhavadante camarīvālavyajanōpaśōbhitamuṁ gajaghaṭāparipāli
tamuṁ kāminījanadante mr̥gamadaparimaḷāmōditamuṁ kr̥ṣṇāgarutiḷakabhū
ṣitamuṁ virahijanadante vividhapallavānilavījyamānamuṁ madanākrāntamuṁ
bālagaḷadante vyāghranakhamuṇḍitamuṁ gaṇḍakābharaṇamuṁ pānapradēśadante pariga
tamadhukōśaśatamuṁ vikīrṇavividhakusumamuṁ daśamukhanagiriyante vānara
bhajyamānatuṅgasālamuṁ praḷayakāladante mahāvarāhasamutpātkhātadharaṇī
maṇḍalamuṁ vivāhagēhadante samitkuśakusumaśamīpalāśōpaśōbhitamuṁ
amarapatigātradante nētrasahasrasaṅkuḷamuṁ avanipati gr̥hadvāradante vētralatā
śataduṣpravēśamuṁ virāṭanagariyante kīcakāvr̥tamuṁ ambaradante vyādhānu
gamyamāna taraḷatārakamr̥gamuṁ gr̥hītavratanante darbhacīrajaṭāvalkala
dhāriyuṁ saptavarṇōpaśōbhitamuṁ krūrasatvanāgiyuṁ munijanasēvita

div.p:
va । mattamalli bandōlāḍuva puḷindasundariyara permoleya po
rkuḷiyoḷ parivariyāda jaladoḷaṁuḷḷalarda kumudakuvalaya kalhāra
kusumaṅgaḷoḷaṁ alarda tāvareya tanivaṇḍina panigaḷiṁ pasarisuva pīligaṇgaḷo
ḷaṁ kārgattale masage musuṟuva maṟidumbiya bambaloḷaṁ ekkekkeyinuliva
jakkavakkigaḷa kaḷakaḷaṅgaḷoḷaṁ tāvarevaṇḍina tanisokkiṁ sokkida peṇṇañcegaḷiñca
raṅgaḷoḷaṁ jalacaraṅgaḷa poḷapinesakadiṁ masagi moṟeva tereduṟugaloḷaṁ ela
ralepadinogeda teregoneyunogevante mēgoneyatūrpaniya tuntuṟugaḷiṁ masaguva mañjino
ḷaṁ añjade pokku naḍunīroḷāḍuva vanadēviyara sōrmuḍiyiṁ paredarala
berakegampina pompuḻiyoḷaṁ ondondeḍeyoḷ tāpasar tīvuva kamaṇḍalu
gaḷinuṇmuva kaḷakaḷadhvanigaḷoḷamōrannamāgi neydilbanadoḷ danigaidāḍuvuda
ṟindariyal bāradepuñcira malladañje viṇḍugaḷoḷa mabhiṣēkakke puḷinda rājasundariyara nelevoleyu sirikaṇḍada taṇpuniṁ poredūṟuviḍidu parviha poṅgēdageya rajadiṁ puḷillaṭṭida pērdoregaḷoḷaṁdaṟiyalvarpañceviṇḍugaḷoḷamabhiṣēkakke bandiḻida puḷindarājasundari
yara nelevoleya sirikaṇḍadaṇpiniṁ poredu beḷarpanānta teregaḷoḷanupānta
doḷ parvida poṅgēdageya rajadiṁ puḻilgaṭṭida perdaṇḍegaḷoḷaṁ muni
janaṅgaḷogedāralikkida taḷirgāsegaḷa sōrdabaṇṇadiṁ beḷargempiḍidu taḍiyoḷ
beḷeda maraṅgaḷa cigurgaḷindogedelariṁ taṇpuvettarpa tīrajalaṅgaḷoḷameḍeviḍida
tamālavīdhiyoḷogeda kaḻtaleyiṁbeḷarvampinoḷaṁ pūraduvendenipa kendaḷirgaḷalepadindeseva taṇṇalara taṇpinoḷaṁ tamālavīdhiyumandaleyottinoḷaṁ r̥ṣyamūka nivāsiyappa sugrīvanindava

biḍu kōlaṁ tuḍu sārdu pordisenutaṁ tantammoḷōrōrvaroḷ

div.p:
va॥anantaramanēka śabarasaṅghātadindaḻiyenondu mr̥daṅgadhvāna
dhīramāgedimbadhiramāgebeṭṭugaḷ mārdaniguḍe gajaṟi garjipa kaṇṭhīrava ravaṅgaḷoḷe
bedaṟi berci kaḍupugaḷaṁ biṭṭu paridondi nindu bhūmitāḍanaṅgeydu mugi
lgaḷ moḻaguvante moḻaguva yūthapatigaḷa br̥ṁhitaṅgaḷoḷaṁ paridu patti
nāygaḷulidu tine jōldu keḍeda hariṇaṅgaḷa kūjitaṅgaḷoḷaṁ baḻisalva maṟi
gaḷverasu kaḷakaḷakke kekkarisi parivr̥tamāgaḷāgaḷe bīḻdu nija yūthapatigaḷaṁ kaṇḍu
pōgalāṟade suḻisuḻidu nilva kariṇigaḷa cītkāradoḷaṁ āgaḷe petta maṟi
gaḷaṁ biṭṭu bedaṟi pōgalāṟadeḷasi nilalāṟade bāyviṭṭodaṟi peḷaṟi pariva
khaḍgidhēnukaṅgaḷa karuṇākrandanaṅgaḷoḷaṁ maratudigōḍugaḷaṁ taṟagelegaḷante
bedaṟi nelakke bīḻva pakkigaḷulupugaḷoḷaṁ bhūmikampamāge pariva mr̥ga
yugaḷa caraṇaghātaśabdaṅgaḷoḷaṁ mahiṣaskandhapīṭhapātitaṅgaḷappa bāḷgaḷa
bāyadhāregaḷa ninādadoḷaṁ eḍeviḍade bedeverasida kurarakūjitaṅgaḷantogeva
saraḷa moṟipadoḷaṁ kūḍe vindhyāṭaviyellaṁ pracalitamādantāge

va॥antā kaḷakaḷaravamaḍaṅgaloḍaneyudbhūtavismayanāgiyadubumayavāgi tande

nuṁ karṇābharaṇīkr̥ta phaṇāmaṇiprabhāruṇita vāmapārśvanuṁ kāḷāga
ruparimaḷāmōditamadakardamakr̥tāṅgarāganuṁ aṅgarāgaparimaḷaprabaddha maṇḍa
lāḷirañjitamayūrapiñchāpatranuṁ vindhyāṭavīkaratalānukāri karṇapalla
vāpanōdita kapōlamaṇḍalīsvēdanuṁ akālasandhyāpradānapravīṇalō
hitalōcananuṁ caṇḍikārudhiradhārāvinihitaśastrōllēkhanaviṣamitabhujayuga
ḷanuṁ mr̥garudhiraśīkararañjitasvēdōbindumālālaṅkr̥taviśālavakṣasthaḷanuṁ
anavarata śramābhyāsakr̥śōdaranuṁ baddha kauśēyavasananuṁ ibhamadamali
nīkr̥tālānastambhadvayōpamānōruyugaḷanuṁ kāḷāyasanigaḷabaddha vāma
pādanuṁ araṇyadante khaḍgadhēnukāsahitanuṁsādanuṁ abhinavajaladharadante mayūra
piñchavicitracāpadharanuṁ bakanantepītāmbaranante gr̥hītaikacakranuṁ garuḍanante samu
ddhr̥tānēkanāgadaśananuṁ nidāghadivasadantāvismr̥tamr̥gatr̥ṣṇanuṁ hiraṇyākṣa
nante mahāvarāhaviśīrṇavakṣasthaḷanuṁ rāgiyante bahuvidhaparigrahanuṁ abhina
vayuvvananāgiyuṁ kṣapitavayasanuṁ kr̥ṣṇanāgiyuṁ asudarśananuṁ kṣitibhr̥
tpādānuvartiyāgiyuṁ rājasēvānabhijñanukr̥tasyatatparāvr̥ttiyāgiyuṁ rujusēnābhijñanumenisidanantalladeyuṁ

va॥adalladeyuṁ giriyante mēkhaḷāḷaṅkr̥tanuṁ drōṇanantasahāya
kr̥pānugatanuṁ nakṣatracakradante nānāmr̥gakr̥ttikāślēṣōpaśōbhitanuṁ
gharmasamayadante kṣapitadōṣanuṁ hariyantapagatanarakabhayanuṁ nītiyuḷḷarasa
nante gūḍhamantrasādhanakṣayitavigrahanuṁ vanacaranāgiyuṁ mahālaya
pravēśanuṁmahārthapravēśanuṁ asaṁyamanāgiyuṁ mōkṣārthiyuṁ sāmaprayōganāgiyuṁ
gr̥hītadaṇḍanuṁ suptanāgiyuṁ prabuddhanuṁ viśālalōcanadvayanāgiyuṁ
tyaktavāmalōcananumenisida munikumāraṁ barutirda baṭṭeyoḷ kaṇṭhagata
prāṇanāgirdennaṁ kaṇḍu

lg.l: giḍugaṁ tandatto mēṇ permarana tudiyinēṟi birdudo sēdeyondu
ggaḍadindaṁ suy podaṟda ṇmidaḻduṇmipudu naḍuguttirduvī kaṇṇalar bā

div.p:
va॥antā giḷiverasu munikumārakaṁ kamaḷākarakke vandu daṇḍa
kamaṇḍalugaḷanondeḍeyoḷirisi

va॥antennaṁ saprāṇanappantu māḍi sakalapariśramaṅgaḷanāṟisi muni
kumāraṁ kr̥tasnānanāgi prāṇāyāmapūrvakamaghamarṣaṇakriyegaḷaṁ
nirvartisi naḷanīdaḷapuṭade kendāvareyalargaḷiṁ divasakaraṅgarghyametti gr̥hīta
dhavaḷavalkalanuṁ nirdhautajaṭākaḷāpanuṁ pūrṇakamaṇḍaḷākalitakarataḷanumā
gennaṁ parṇapuṭadoḷ taḷidu nirvartitaniyuyamarappa munikumārar berasu
nijāśramakke pōgevōge

va॥mattaṁ mārīcamāyāmr̥gapracārabhūmibhāgadiṁ daśarathasuta
cāpakōṭikṣatakandagartaviṣamitasthalaṅgaḷoḷameseva daṇḍakāraṇyasthaḷagaḷināśra
mamupāśrayambaḍevudantumalladeyuṁ
va॥mattammalli

lg.l: kuladiṁ celvāda r̥ṣyāśramamuda racaneyaṁ nōḍutuṁ pōdenāgaḷ

div.p:
va॥antuṭajāṅgaṇadoḷ parapida palateṟada phalaṅgaḷiṁ śrutimukhara
mukhaṅgaḷappa śukaśārikegaḷiṁ munikumārakaraneḷasi mellamellane nakkuveḷevulle
gaḷiṁ jaradandhatāpasara kayyampiḍideḍapalīyade naḍeyisuva capaḷamarkaṭaṁ
gaḷiṁ munijanaṅgaḷge kōḍugaḷiṁ kandamūlaphalaṅgaḷanaguḷdu koḍuva vanahariṇa
gaḷiṁ karapuṣkaraṅgaḷiṁ tandu pūgiḍugaḷge nīreṟiṟeva maṟiyānegaḷiṁ muni
kumārarge handigeḍḍeyuṁyaṁ dāḍeyindaguḷdu nīḍuva vanavarāhaṅgaḷiṁ tammoṟimmeṟiṁ
keya gāḷiyiṁ pogeyaṁ nandisalīyade hōmānalaprajvalanamanesaguva
sōgenavilgaḷiṁ sogayisuvudantumalladeyuṁ

va॥mattamasurāriyante prakaṭita harivarāhamuṁ sāṅkhyadante kapi
ḷādhiṣṭhitamuṁ udayananantānanditavatsakuḷamuṁ samudradante vanagahanamadhya
suptahariyuṁ mātaṅgakuḷadūṣitamāgiyumatipavitramumullasitadhūma
kētuśatamāgiyuṁ praśāntōpadravamuṁ paripūrṇadvijarājasanāthamāgi
yuṁ tarugahanāndhakāritamumappudantumalladeyuṁ

va॥mattaṁ malinate hōmadhūmadoḷ mukharāgaṁ giḷigaḷoḷ
tīkṣṇatvaṁ kuśāgraṅgaḷoḷ sañcaḷatvaṁ kadaḷīvanaṅgaḷoḷ nayanarāgaṁ
kōkilaṅgaḷoḷ kaṇṭhagrahaṇaṁ kamaṇḍalaṅgaḷoḷ stanasparśanaṁ hōmadhēnu
gaḷoḷ vasusaṅkīrtanaṁ divyakathegaḷoḷ rāmānurāgaṁ rāmāyaṇadoḷ
bhramaṁ hōmāgnipradakṣiṇaṅgaḷoḷ mukhabhaṅgavikāraṁ jareyoḷ śakunivadhaṁ
bhāratadoḷ vāyupralapitaṁ purāṇadoḷ dvijapatanaṁ vayaḥpariṇati
yoḷ jāḍyamupavanaśrīkhaṇḍataruṣaṇḍaṅgaḷoḷ nr̥tyapakṣapātaṁ navilgaḷoḷ
gītavyasanaṁ mr̥gaṅgaḷoḷ bhōgaṁ bhujaṅgaṅgaḷoḷ śrīphaḷābhilāṣaṁ kapi
gaḷoḷ adhōgati bērgaḷoḷallade tannoḷillenisi bēṟondu brahmalōka
dantirpudantumalladeyuṁ

pāṟipōkumalladantu paricayadiṁ nilgendenna sambandhamuṁ nuḍivuttire

dendu puṇya jaladiṁ prakṣāḷisuvante śāntadr̥ṣṭigaḷindennaṁ munnaṁ kaṇḍaṟiva
nante nīḍuṁ bhāvisi nōḍi

va॥mattamaśōkataruvinante taruṇīpadaprahārasaṅkrāntālaktarāga
nuṁmaṁ tāḷdiyuṁ haṁsanante ramaṇīyanūpuraninādānanditamānasasarōvara
noḷ carisiyuṁ bhramaradante kusumamañjarīrañjitalatābhavanaṅgaḷoḷ
bhramisiyuṁ kāminījanadattasaṅkētabhavanaṅgaḷoḷ bahuḷanitāntapramōdasadanaṅdaṅga
ḷoḷ bhramisiyuṁ vighaṭitakanakakavāṭavātāyanaṅgaḷappaspa mahāprāsāda
sadanaṅgaḷoḷ kuḷirduṁḷsuṟiduṁ samitāstrajananoḍanantaḥpurakāminīparasparatana
nēkavīṇāvēṇumuravajanunnōpananōcaraṅgaḷappaspa saṅgītaṅgaḷaṁ nistriḷaṁvistarisiyuṁ ati
nuṇīcaturīyumabhinutanuviruddhanesanisiviṣayasukhārṇavanodoḷ mūḍi muḻgāḷgāḍu
trattamirdanantumalladeyuṁ
va॥adukāraṇadiṁ

va॥mattamā dharādhīśvaraṅge harajaṭākaḷāpakke candralēkheyante
nārāyaṇavakṣasthalakke kaustubhaprabheyante diggajakke madalēkheyante vasanta
samayakke kusumōdgamadante mānasasarōvarakke haṁsamāleyante malayā
calakke candanarājiyante viḷāsavatiyembaḷantaḥpurapradhāneyenisida mahā
dēviyaramanege dinadinaṁ tārāpīḍa narēndraṁ baruttamiralannegaṁ

va॥āgaḷantaḥpuravr̥sthaddhāṅganāśvāsyamāneyumaviraḷāśrubindudhārā
rdrīdrīkr̥tadukūleyumanaḷaṅkr̥teyuṁ vāmakarataḷavinihitamukhakamaḷeyuṁ
paryaṅkōpaviṣṭeyumāgaḷuttirda viḷāsavatimahādēviyuṁyaṁ tārāpīḍa
narēndraṁ kaṇḍu kr̥tapratyutthāneyāda nallaḷaṁ mellane kuḷḷirisi tānuṁ mellane
kuḷḷirdajñātakāraṇaṁ bāṣpavidendātmakarataḷadindā kuṭilāḷakiya nayanajalaṁ
gaḷaṁ toḍedu

va॥endu śōkakāraṇamanentu besagoṇḍoḍaṁ pēḻide viḷāsavati
mahādēvi bāṣpāmbusantatiyane suriyuttamirpuduṁ keladoḷirda sakhīka
dambada mogamaṁ nōḍe santatasannihiteyappa tāmbūlakaraṅkavāhini makarike
yembaḷintendaḷ—

va॥adalladeyuminduvaraṁ dēvara manaṁ nondapudendu manandōṟiṟa
dirpaḷindu mahākāḷadēvaraṁ pūjisuttamirpalli bhāratakathāśravaṇadoḷ
‘punnāmnō narakāttrātrāyata iti putraḥ aāputrāṇāṁ kila gatirnāsti navā
santi lōkā ḥ śubhā ḥ’ embīvākyārthamaṁ kēḷdu

va॥enutte viśvānandabhavananappātmasambhavananā mahānubhāvaṁ biḍade
bhāvisi nijaprāṇēśvariya mogamuṁ nōḍi

lg.l: inabimbaṁ kaṇgaḷumbaṁ toḷagi beḷage bālātapaṁ suttaluṁ kaṁ
panegaḷ tōrada mandahāsaruci muddaṁ nāḍeyuṁ bīṟi rō
bārele tande bārarasa bā porevāḻdine bāyenutte vi

div.p:
va॥endivu modalāgi palavuṁ manōrathaṅgaḷaṁ cintisuttamirdu
mattaṁ priyamadhuraṅgaḷuṁ śōkāpanōdanipuṇaṅgaḷuṁ dharmōpadēśagarbhaṅga
ḷumappa vacananicayaṅgaḷinentānuṁ santaisi nijaparijanamberasarasaṁ bijayaṅge
ydanalliṁ baḻiṟikkaṁ viḷāsavatimahādēvi duḥkhamuṁ pattuviṭṭindinantābharaṇaṁ
gaḷaṁ toṭṭu

lg.l: sale nile bēva gugguḷada karpogeyindanumugurvanāḷda ka

div.p:
va॥mattaṁ gōrōcanāracita bhūrjapatragarbharakṣāmaṇigaḷaṁ
tāḷdiyuṁ ōṣadhisūtracayamuṁ taḷeduṁ upaśrutigaḷaṁ kēḷdu madhvaṅgaḷoḷ
jambukaṅgaḷge māṁsabalisamanvitōpahāraṅgaḷaṁ māḍisiyumintanēkavidhadiṁ
viḷāsavatimahādēvi putrōtpattinimittaṁ palavu divasamācarisuttamirpu
dumondudivasaṁ
va॥ādalladeyuṁ

va॥ānumī mārgadoḷ kaṇḍenantu niśāvasānasamayadoḷ kaṇḍa
kanasugaḷavitathaṅgaḷappuppavadukāraṇadiṁ nikhiḷarājar̥ṣipramōdahētubhūtanuṁ
rājamāndhātanumenipa jagatprakhyātaṁ janiyisugumamudalladeyuṁ

va॥endu tārāpīḍanarēndrana kayyaṁ piḍidantaḥpurakke pōgi viḷā
savati mahādēvige tāvirvaruṁ kaṇḍa kanasugaḷaṁ pēḻdu kēḷdānandaparampareyayu
neydi kelavānuṁ divasadoḷ
va॥antaccarivaṭṭaṅgitakuśalayarappa parijanaṅgaḷaṟiyuttirdalli

lg.l: ttenagiṁ māṇdiralēṁ praśastamenisirdī rātriyoḷ pōgi bhū
haranō pēḻiḻemenal pradīpanivahaṅgaḷ suttaluṁ kūḍi ta

div.p: va॥antirdavanipatiyaṁyuṁ kaṇḍu poḍavaṭṭu vaṁśavardhane kuḷḷirdu
va॥antaṟipaloḍane

va॥antu nōḻpuduṁ śukanāsanāmuma mantri pordi narēndraṅgiṁ
tendaṁ

va॥antu śukanāsaṁ besagoḷvuḷpuduṁ darahasitavadanāravindanāgi narēndra
nintendaṁ

lg.l: ivaḷīgaḷ pēḻda mātā kanasanavitathaṁ māḻpa mātappuvāgi
durvavaṁ viśvāsisal bandapude. piridumantappudaṁ kēḷva bhāgyaṁ
havidēkēḻ pōgi nāvalliye diṭanudu tānembudaṁ nōḻpamatte

div.p:
va॥endu narēndraṁ rājalōkamaṁ visarjisi tanna vaṁśavardhanegaṅgeṅga
citramanittu śukanāsamberasāsthānamaṇṭapadiṁ poṟamaḍuvāgaḷ

va॥antu tatsamayasēvāsamucita viraḷaparijanānugavyamānaṁ śuka
nāsamberasoḷagaṁ pokku vasukr̥tarakṣāsaṁvidhānamaṁ navasudhānulēpanakalita
muṁmaṁ prajvalitamaṅgaḷapradīpamuṁmaṁ pūrṇakalaśādhiṣṭhitadvārapakṣamuṁmaṁ pratyagra
likhita maṅgaḷālēkhyōjvaḷabhittibhāgamuṁmaṁ uparacitavitatasitavitānaparyanta
saktamuktāguṇamuṁmaṁ maṇipradīpāvabhāsamumenisida nivāsabhavanadoḷ.
va॥antirdaḷaṁ kaṇḍu nivāsabhavanamuṁmaṁ pugutarpāgaḷ

va॥anantaramupārūḍhagarbheyappa nijavallabheyaṁ nōḍi harṣanirbhara
mānasamarasaṁ prastutaparihāsavacanadinintendaṁ

lg.l: nnanamātyaṁ besagoṇḍapaṁ besasenal mandasmitaṁ poṇme mā

div.p: va॥antu nōḍpuḻpuduṁ narēndraṁ nasunaguttaminvintendaṁ

lg.l: āṁ nuḍidīgaḷī nuḍige lajjisidappe latāṅgi māṇde nā

div.p:
va॥endu tārāpīḍaṁ kāḍutirpudumantarnigūḍhahāsyaṁ śukanāsa
nintendaṁ

lg.l: rdhane pēḻdalliya māta nīṁ maṟiṟeyenuttallinde narmapriyā

div.p:
va॥ittal sannihita garbhadōhada sampādanadiṁ viḷāsavatīmahā
dēviyaṁ pramuditeyappantu negaḻuttamire kelavānuṁ divasadoḷ prasavasa
mayapuṇyadinavāge gaṇakagaṇaṁ gr̥hītachāyāmānarāgi śubhalagnamaṁ
pāruttamirpannegaṁ

va॥antā mahātmajātajananōtsavadoḷ sarabhasapradhāvita parijana
caraṇa saṅkṣōbhakṣuṇṇakṣititaḷamuṁ bhūpālābhimukha prasr̥ta kañcuki
sahasrasammardaniṣpiṣyamāṇakubjavāmanagaṇamuṁ viṣphāsphāryamāṇāntaḥpurajanā
bharaṇa jhuṅkāramanōharamuṁ pūrṇapātraharaṇaviluṭhyamānavasanabhūṣaṇa
muṁ saṅkṣōbhita nagaramumenisi mahāsambhramaṁ vijr̥mbhisuvudumambhōdhi
gambhīradundubhidhvānapurassaramāgi rājamandiradoḷ mr̥dumr̥daṅgaśaṅkha
kahaḷārāvanirbharapaṭaharavaṅgaḷiseye anēkasahasrajanasaṅkulaṅgaḷiṁ tribhuvana
mellamuṁ tekkane tīvuvānanda bahuḷakōlāhalaṁ negeye samastasāmanta
santatiyu maśēṣāntaḥpuramumumakhiḷarājalōkamuṁ ābālagōpāla prakr̥ti
yellamumatiharṣanirbharateyiṁ bhōrgaredārdu nalidu nartisuttamire
va॥antā samayadoḷ

va॥āgaḷ maṇimaya kalaśavilasitamuṁ vividhaputrikāvicitramuṁ
pallavanivahanirantaramuṁ kāñcanamayakamalamusalahalakalitamuṁ sitakusuma
miśritadūrvāpravāḷālaṅkr̥tamuṁ vyāghracarmasāndramuṁ vandana
mālāntarāḷaghaṭita ghaṇṭāgaṇamumenisida sūtikābhavana dvāradēśadoḷ
nivāritaparivāranāgi śukanāsasamanvitaṁ puguvalli uttānavinihitavarāṭaka
prakaradanturaṅgaḷuṁ vividhavarṇarāgarucira kārpāsakusumalāñchitaṅgaḷuṁ
kusumbhakēsaralavāślēṣalōhitamukhaṅgaḷumāgi rañjisuva raṅgavalligaḷumaṁ
vikacapakṣamaṇḍitaśikhaṇḍivāhananuṁ ālōlalōhitapaṭapatākanuṁ ullasita
śaktidaṇḍanumenisida kārtikēyanumuṁmaṁ alaktakapaṭaḷa pāṭaḷarappa sūryācandra
masarumuṁmaṁ kuṅkumapaṅkapiñjarīkr̥taṅgaḷuṁ ūrdhvaprōtakanakamayayava
nikaraṅgaḷuṁ aviraḷagaurasiddhārthyaprakaraṅgaḷumenisida mr̥ṇmayaṅgaḷappa ghaṭikāka
dambaṅgaḷumaṁ candanarasadhavaḷitabhittibhāgāñcita pañcarāgavicitracēlakaḷāpa
cihnaṅgaḷumaṁ vardhamānakaparamparegaḷumaṁ innumanēka prasavagr̥hamaṇḍa
naṅgaḷumaṁ sampādisuva purandhriyaroḷaṁ gugguḷaphaṇikañcukaviṣāṇarēṇu
gaḷinde karvorpogeyiḍuva sarvarakṣādhūpa dhūmaṅgaḷoḷaṁ śāntyudakamaṁ taḷivava
nīvr̥ndārakavēdaghōṣaṇaṅgaḷoḷaṁ mātr̥gaṇapūjāvidhānatatpararāda dhātrī
janaṅgaḷoḷaṁ maṅgaḷamaṁ pāḍuva śuddhāntavr̥ddhāṅganeyaroḷaṁ kanakadaṇḍāgra
maṇḍitamāgi beḷaguva maṅgaḷapradīpaṅgaḷoḷaṁ utpātkhātāsilatāsanāthapāṇi
gaḷappa rakṣāpuruṣaroḷameseva sūtikāgr̥hamaṁ tārāpīḍanarēndraṁ puguvuduṁ
prasavaparikṣāmapāṇḍumūrtiyappa viḷāsavatī mahādēviyutsaṅgadoḷ
tanna beḷage beḷagāge
va॥antu kaṇḍu

va॥āgaḷ śukanāsaṁ kumāranaṅgapratyaṅgaṅgaḷaṁ prītivistārita
lōcananāgi nōḍi narēndraṅgintendaṁ,

va॥antaḥpuradvāradēśadoḷirda rājalōkamellamaṁ sambhramaṁ berasu
tolagalorvapuruṣaṁ prahr̥ṣṭavadanaṁ tvaritagatiyiṁ bandu poḍamaṭṭu binnapa
mendintendaṁ

va॥anantaramosagevātaṁ pēḻdavaṅge mamuccugoṭṭallindeḻdu poṟa
maṭṭu nōḻpinnagamalli kvaṇitamaṇinūpura sahasramukharita digantamuṁ ati
rabhasōpacalita maṇivalayāvaḷī viḷasitabhujalatāpratānamumuttānakarataḷa
naḷinamuṁ mr̥muṁvr̥dita karṇapūrapallavamuṁ anyōnyāṅgadasaṅghaṭṭanasandaṣṭapāṭi
tōttarīyamuṁ nijāṅgarāgarañjitavasanamuṁ avaśiṣṭamakarikāpatra
lēkhamuṁ ālōlahāralatāsphālitakucakumbhasthaḷamuṁ sindhūratilakāruṇita
cikuranikuramuṁ piṣṭātapāṁsupuñjapiñjaritakēśapāśamuṁ pranr̥vr̥tta khañja
mūka kubja vāmana kirātajanapurassaramumuttarīyāṁśukākr̥ṣṭa jara
tkañcukinikāyamuṁ vīṇāvēṇu muraja kāṁsyatāḷalayānugatamenisi
dantaḥpuraviḷāsinījanamuṁ pracalanmaṇikuṇḍalāhata gaṇḍamaṇḍalamuṁ ghūrṇa
māna karṇōtpalamuṁ adhōvigaḷita vilōla śēkharamuṁ ḍōlāyamāna
vaikakṣakakusumamālamuṁ bhērī mr̥daṅga mardaḷa paṭaha kahaḷāśaṅkharavajanita
rabhasamumenisida rājaparijanamuṁ nr̥tyapranr̥vr̥tta cāraṇagaṇamuvomosagevuvaru
ḷgoṇḍu bhōrgaredu nalidu narttirtisuttamoḍane barevare.

va॥antu negaḻci daśamadina puṇyasumuhūrtadoḷ suvarṇakōṭi
gaḷaṁ dvijōttamargittu tadanantaradoḷ

lg.l: modaloḷ bandaḻkecindīṭkaṟindītatana jananiya vaktrābjadoḷ candramaṁmuṁ po
kkudanalte kaṇḍe nāṁ svapnadoḷenute manaṅgoṇḍu tatsvapnasādr̥
śyade candrāpīḍanembī modala pesaraniṭṭaṁ tanūjaṅge mūlō

div.p:
va॥anantaramēḻgavaḍeda pāḍivada candramanante candrāpīḍaṁ prati
dinaṁ pravr̥ddhamānanāge cūḍākaraṇādi kriyākalāpamumaṁmuṁ māḍuttamire
śaiśavamaṁmuṁ pattuviḍuvudaṁ krīḍāvyasanamugalvantu bahirnagaradoḷamaravanmandi
rānukāriyappa vidyānikētanamaṁ māḍisi nikhiḷa vidyācāryarumaṁ mahā
prayatnadiṁ nilisi śubhadinadoḷ dhavaḷamaṅgaḷaprasādhanālaṅkr̥tanumācārya
kulaparivr̥tanumappa nijanandananaṁ vaiśampāyanaṁ berasu vidyādhigamamunadoḷ
samarpisi pañjarasthita madakēsarikiśōrakadantegeydu khiḷa vidyābhyāsaṅgeyyuysutta
mire

va॥antu sakaḷakalāḷākaḷāpamanappugeydu śastraśāstradoḷatyanta pari
ṇatanāguttamireyire

div.head: candrāpīḍana jaitrayātre
div.p:
va॥antupārūḍhanavayauvanōdayanuṁ parisamāptasakalakalāvijñā
nanumāda nijanandananappa candrāpīḍanaṁ tārāpīḍa narēndraṁ barisalendu
balādhikr̥tanappa balāhakanembanaṁ besase bahuturaṅgapadātibalaparivr̥tanāgi
balāhakaṁ kumāranirda vidyānikētanakkevandu dauvārikanivēditaṁ pokku
vibudhacintāmaṇiyuṁyaṁ kaṇḍavanitaḷanihita cūḍāmaṇiyāgi poḍavaṭṭu samu
citāsanadoḷ kuḷḷirdu vinayapurassaramintendaṁ

lg.l: kkinnaḍetandu dēva paḍe paurajanaṅgaḷa kaṇge parvamaṁmuṁ

div.p:
va॥adalladeyuṁ mūrdhābhiṣikta pārthivakulaprasūtaruṁ vinayō
papannaruṁ kōvidaruṁ kulakramāgatarumappa rājaputrasahasramumaṁ ninage
parivārārthamuṭṭidanavarellaruṁ poṟage turagārūḍhar praṇānulālasarāgi
bāgiloḷ pārdirparendu balāhakaṁ binnavisuvuduṁ nr̥parūpacandraṁ
tandeyājñayaṁ taleyoḷ tāḷdu poṟaṟinuḍalendabhinava jaḷadharadhvāna gabhīra
vacanadinindrāyudhamaṁ pugisendu besasidāgaḷ

lg.l: eraḍuṁ pakkaṅgaḷoḷ kāñcana kaṭaka khalīmuṇī nāgrasaṁlagnarīrvar
barepīrvantettamākāśamananila javōdrēkadiṁ nūṟunūrthāsiramuṁ meṭṭuttu vombare ninamidiraṁpāṟi nīḍuṁ

div.p:
va॥munnaṁ sthūḷaśiranemba tāpasanitta śāpadinakhilaḷa lōkadoḷ
rūpindaccariyādaccariyappa rambhe suralōkamaṁ biṭṭu mr̥ttikāvatiyemba
rājadhāniyoḷirpa śatadhanvanembarasana maneyoḷ gōḷigeyāgi palavukāla
mirdaḷuḷadumalladeyuṁ palabar mahātmar mahāmunijana śāpadiṁ parihr̥ta
prabhāvarāgiharaprabharūpāgi palavumākr̥tigaḷaṁ taḷedu martyalōkadoḷ cariyisu
tirparembudamaṁ kēḷdudillakkume enuttamāvā divyāśvamanaccarivaṭṭu nōḍutta
mirdu

lg.l: idu sāmānyada vājiyultu piriduṁ nōḍal munīndrōgraśā
kanumukhaṁ nōḍuttamēṟal karerava teṟadetaṟida hēṣāravaṁ poṟmeṇme bhūbhā

div.p:
va॥antadanēṟi divyavājiya mahājavamaṁ kaṇḍu bhuvanatrayamaṁ
prādēśamātramāgi bagedu poṟamaḍuvannegamalli

va॥antu candrōdayakṣubhitasāgaradante bāgiloḷ ghūrṇisu
tirda rājalōkamahamahamikeyiṁ praṇāmumalālasarāge balādhikāriyappa
balāhakanavaravara pesargoṇḍu poḍamaḍise

va॥tadanantaramā narēndracandramuṁmaṁ yathākramadiṁ turaṅgā
rūḍhanappa vaiśampāyanamberasu purābhimukhanāgi bijayaṅgeyvāgaḷ

va॥adalladeyuṁ palateṟada paṟiṟegaḷiḍeyoḷ bājisuva padirapaṟiṟe
gaḷumottuva sannegāḷegaḷuṁ pūrisuva śaṅkhaṅgaḷuṁ ōduva vandimāgadhara
jayajayādi madhuraravaṅgaḷumeseye rājadhānigabhimukhanāgi manujēndra
candraneydiytarpāgaḷ

va॥anteantiseva nagarīratnaracitōttuṅga maṅgaḷatōraṇaṅgaḷaṁ nusuḷu
ttuṁ barpa rūpavidyādharanaṁ nōḍalendu nelemāḍaṅgaḷanēṟida nīṟaṟiya
ralaktaka rāgarañjitapadapallavaṅgaḷi navanitaḷamellaṁ pallavisidanteyuṁ ā nitambini
yara vadanēndubimbanikurambadinambarataḷaṁ candramaṇḍalamumayamādanteyuṁ
ā lāvaṇyavatiyarātapakketrittida kendaḷaṅgaḷa sandaṇiyiṁ dikcakramellaṁ kendāvare
goḷanalardanteyumā ramaṇīya ramaṇiyarābharaṇakiraṇakaḷāpaṅgaḷiṁ taraṇi
kiraṇaṅgaḷellamindracāpalatāvitānadantireyumā kāminiyara kamanīya
lōcanamarīcigaḷindaṁ dinaṁ vikasitanīlanīrajākaradantireyumatikautuka
dindīkṣisuvalli

va॥mattamunuparisamāptaprasādhaneyarāgi bandu nōḍuvalli
mattorvaḷ
va॥mattalli
va॥mattalli,

va॥mattamā latāṅgiyar sūsuva kusumamiśralājāñjali
gaḷanidirgoḷuttañjanagirīṁdramālāmalinadrāgrāyamānamādakuñjaraghaṭābhirañjitamuṁ u
ddaṇḍadhavaḷātapatrasañchannamumanēkadvīpāntarāgata dūtasamākuḷamumappa
rā jabhavanadvāradoḷindrāyudhadindavanitaḷakkavatarisi vaiśampāyanakarakamalani
ṣṭhiṣmitaprakōṣṭhanuṁ balāhakōpadiśyamānamārganumāgi pokkanēkasahasrajana
saṅkuḷamappa saptakakṣyāntaragaḷanatikramisi barpalli

lg.l: karumāḍaṁ nāḍe celvaṁ taḷedudu palavuṁ baḷḷimāḍaṅgaḷindaṁ

div.p:
va॥antirda nijajanakanaṁ nayaratnākaraṁ dūradoḷe kaṇḍavanitaḷa
nihita cūḍāmaṇiyāgi poḍamaḍuvuduṁ

va॥antu vinayōnnativetta nijanandanananardhāsanadoḷā nr̥paṁ kuḷḷi
riseyumentuvolladātmīyatāmbūlakaraṅkavāhakaprasāritāmbarāñcalamu
maṁ caraṇāgradiṁ nūṅki candrāpīḍaṁ neladoḷ kuḷḷire

va॥endu nijajanakaṁ besasalantegeyvenendu vaiśampāyanadvitīyanuṁ
antaḥpurapravēśayōgyaparimitaparijanōpadiśyamānamārganumāgi śuddhānta
kāntāpradhāneyappa nijāmbikeya maneyaṁ puguvalli vasanābharaṇakusumapaṭa
vāsatāmbūlatāḷavr̥ntāṅgarāgabhr̥ṅgārudhāriṇiyarappavāraviḷāsiniyaroḷaṁ
ubhayapārśvōddhūtadhavaḷacāmareyarappa jamarījakānteyaroḷaṁ purāṇa
kathākathanatatparaparivrājakāsamūhadoḷamupāsyamāneyāgirdaḷantu malla
deyuṁ

va॥antirdaḷaṁ geṇṭanoḷ kaṇḍu vinayaratnākaraṁ sāṣṭāṅgapraṇata
nāge

va॥anantaraṁ vaiśampāyananumanaḻkaṟiṁ taḷkaisi viḷāsavatimahā
dēvi kuḷḷirdu vinayadiṁ neladoḷ kuḷḷirda vaiśampāyananumaṁ maguḻe
maguḻe tegedu taḷkaisutamirdu

va॥tadanantaraṁ samastajananiyarumaṁ yathākramadinabhivandisi rāja
mandiramaṁ poṟamuṭṭu sakalarājalōkamberasu mahāmātya śukanāsanara
manege vandu

va॥antu poḍavaṭṭu paramāśīrvādaṅgaḷanāntu tadanantaradoḷ
poṟamuṭṭu barpāgaḷ

va॥adalladeyumābaddhacandanamālābhirañjitamumudgatasitapatā
kāsahasrasaṅkuḷamumabhyāhatamaṅgaḷapaṭupaṭaharavāpūritamuṁ upapāditā
śēṣagr̥hapravēśamaṅgaḷumumappa nijamandiramampokku narēndracakramaṁ
yathākramadiṁ mannisi majjanabhōjanādi divasavyāpāramaṁ tīrci
va॥antu turaṅgaratnamane nōḍi poḻtugaḷeyuttamirpuduṁ

lg.l: vanegeytarpalli kāliṁ navamaṇimaya mañjīrakaṁ nuṇbuṇcutaṁ tī

div.p:
va॥tadanantaraṁ kr̥ṣṇāgarupaṅkalategaḷante timirarēkhegaḷ nimireyuṁ

bīrvar kanneyariṁ gandharvakulamudayisidudalli citrasēnādigaḷappa
padinnaivariṁ piriyanenisi

varamumādudalladeyuṁ tumburaprabhr̥tigaḷappaṟuvariṁ piriyanenisi

kimpuruṣāvāsasthānamāgirpudalli
va॥mattamā sōmamayūkhasambhaveyarappaccarasiyaroḷage

nōṭpaḻpalli śikharirājanandini pūjisalendu taṭaśilātaladoḷ bareda mr̥ḍana
paḍivariṟijaṁ kaṇḍu kumbiṭṭāḻdā sarastīradēśadalli

kusumamugandhamanāghrāṇisutamidettaṇadendu kautukaṁ migaladaṟa baḻiṭṭeviḍidu

lg.l: īgurutina padyagaḷu asthānakavigaḷāda basappaśāstrigaḷinda racisalpaṭṭavu. mūladavalla.aārasañcegaḷoḍavare nē
ī gurutina padyagaḷu āsthānakavigaḷāda basappaśāstrigaḷinda racisalpaṭṭavu, mūladavalla.giriśanayanānalārciyi

div.p: va॥antumalladeyuṁ

va॥antumalladeyuṁ brahmacaryakkalaṅkāramuṁ dharmakke navayavva
namuṁ sarasvatige līlāvilāsamuṁ vidyāpratatige svayaṁvarapatiyuṁ samasta
śrutigaḷige saṅkētanikētanamumenisidanalladeyuṁ

lg.l: rcanege vanakke bandu posavūgaḷanartiyoḷāydu koyduyda be
nnane baralī vanāntara sarōvaradallige mīyalendu me
llane barutirda tanmunikumārana nāṁ biḍenōḍideṁ nr̥pā

div.p: va॥antu nōḻpannegaṁ
va॥antu bhāvisuttuṁ ā munikumāravadanēndubimbamaṁ nōḍi

lg.l: siri nalavindamirpa nele kaṇgaḷa parvamenippa paṅkajō
haramene mūmāḍidī mogada pōlvege munnegaḻiṭil taguḷci bi

div.p: va॥mattaṁ
va॥endu rūpaippaikapakṣapātamuṁmaṁ bhāvisuttamirpuduṁ

va॥anantaramusiroḍanemeyikkuvudaṁ maṟedaṁmuṟidu paripandupatralavvaḷisi
kaḷavaḷisi koṅki baḷasuveḷasuvalargaṅgaḷiṁ tadrūpalāvaṇyarasamanaḻkaṟiṁ bare
pīrvante ninagoḷagādenembante manamamunaṅgayyallikki tōrpenembante tanmaya
māgaloḍaripenembante madananaledapaṁ kāyennanembante śaraṇbuguvenembante
manadoḷeḍeguḍendaḷupaṁ tōṟuvante kulahīnakanyakājanōcitamatilajjākara
manōrathavidenagetakkudalladudaṁ negaḻdenenḻdendaṟivenāgiyuṁ atyāsaktiyiṁ
maṟevaṭṭaranteyuṁ citrisidaranteyuṁ mūrchevōdaranteyuṁ ārānuṁ piḍike
vettaranteyuṁ miḍukade nōḍutirdenannegaṁ

lg.l: dāgaḷe karcidante neṟe pōdudu lajje maraḷdu tanmahā

div.p: va॥antu begaḍugoṇḍu
va॥antāścaryamuṁmaṁ taḷedu nanna nāne santaisi

va॥endu pōgaludyōgaṅgeydu nikhiḷajanapūjārharanavajñegeyya
lāgadendu

lg.l: toḷaguva cenna pūgaḷalakāvaḷiyoḷ miṟugal kapōla muṁmaṁ

div.p: va॥tadanantaraṁ

lg.l: ḍḍida dīpāṅkuradante tanmuniyumuṁmaṁ kāmuṁmaṁ calaṁ māḍidaṁ

div.p: va॥antu māḍe

lg.l: manamennaṁ mumbaral munduvarivudane tōrpante nīḷdattu suy bhōṁ

div.p: va॥antumalladeyuṁ

lg.l: manadondaḻki ṟīḷoḷiṭkiṟoḷenna noldaḍare nōḍuttirpuduṁ kaṇṇa be

div.p:
va॥anteydi mattamennoḷ sambhōgalīlānartanakkōjanappa
manōjaṁ vilāsōpadēśakkōjanāgalēḻkumalladandu ratirasāsvādanaṁ
gaḷanaṟiyadana diṭṭegamardanuguḻvantegeyvandamuṁ osedu paridappudenipa rati
rasamuvānandabāṣpaprasaramuṁ rasabhāradiṁ naḍaguvante sañcaḷisuvaṅgamuṁ
inisappoḍaṁ poḍarpanappappu kayyadiḻiye pūdaḷidudenipa purbinakuḍiverasu
tūkaḍanoḷakoṇḍa jāḍyamuṁ sokku mukkuḷisidantirdiravuṁ baḻiṭildante
jōldandamuṁ munnamabhyāsamilladudarkentu dorekoḷgumendu bhāvisi
nōḍuttātanoḷavasarambaḍedu mellaneydiydevandu
va॥antu besagoḷe

va॥ādentene sakalamunivr̥ndavanditacaraṇanumakhila munijanānanda
nanuṁ viditaniravadyavidyākalāpanumapratimarūpanumumapporba śvētakētu
vemba mahāmuniyumaralōkadoḷirpanātanondu divasaṁ puṇḍarīkamemba
sarōvaramaṁ mīyalendu bandire
va॥antu nōḍe

va॥āgaḷātaṁ yōgadr̥ṣṭiyiṁ nōḍi tatkumāranaṁ kaikoṇḍu
bālajanmōcitakriyegaḷaṁ māḍi janmānurūpamāge puṇḍarīkanendu pesa
raniṭṭu śaiśavamuṁmaṁ pattuviḍaloḍamakhiḷa vidyākalāpadoḷ pariṇatanaṁ māḍi
yatitvamuṁmaṁ kaikoḷise tadanuṣṭhānaparāyaṇanāda mahānubhāvanītaṅgī vrata
viruddhamappa kusumamañjariyentubandudembeyappoḍe

va॥antu bandu poḍamavaṭṭu bhuvanatrayābhirāmanumappa ninna
saukumāryakke takkalaṅkāramī divyakusumamañjariyanavataṁsaṁ māḍi pāri
jātajanmamuṁmaṁ saphalaṁmāḻpenendu binnavise nijarūpastutige lajjisi kēḷadanvante
pōge mattaṁ bennane patti barutirpudumāṁ kaṇḍu kāruṇyadindī kāntege
santōṣaṁmāḍimenalivēke bēḍavēḍeneyuṁ kiviyoḷ toḍarci pōvadaḷī
kusumanuñmañjariyanendu sahacaramuni pēḻiḻdu puṇḍarīkaṁ darahasitādhara
kapōlatalanāgi

lg.l: caḷisuttaṁ nijakarṇadiṁ tegedu sōltaṁlteṁ kūḍu nīnennoḷeṁḷaṁ

div.p: va॥antu pōdoḍamuṟīmaṟiyadire
va॥antā vyatirēkamōḷinna chatradhāriṇi nōḍi
va॥antavaḷeḷinnanentānuṁ tegeye

lg.l: ṭidudō mēṇ subhagatvavemba guṇadiṁ poldatto mēṇimbinaṁ

div.p:
va॥alliṁ taḷarvudumattaloḍaneye kumāranātana dhairyaskhalaneyuṁyaṁ
nōḍi
va॥endu māṇade
va॥antumalladeyuṁ

va॥adaṟininnādoḍaṁ ninna manamaṁ nīṁ nilisikoḷḷendu nuḍiye
lajjitanādantegeydu

va॥antu makaradhvajalāsyārambhalīlāpuṣpāñjaliyenisidēkāvaḷiyaṁ
tegedu kuḍuvudumātanuṁ manmukhāsakta dr̥ṣṭiyiṁ meyyaṟiyadakṣāvaḷi
gettu kaḷedukoḷpuḷvudumūnāgaḷalliṁ taḷardu

va॥antoyyal nijajananiyoḍanentānumaramanege bandu madīya
mandiramaṁ pokku tadviyōgadoḷ meyyaṟiyade

lg.l: manegēṁ bandeno bārenō sakhiyaroḷ kūḍirdenō kūḍadi
ṇidu duḥkhavo rujeyo kaḷavaḷavo pēḻidu po

div.p:
va॥anantaraṁ sakhījanamumanaśēṣaparijanamumaṁ bāgiloḷ nilisi
kanyāntaḥpuraprāsādamanēṟi tadīyamaṇigavākṣanikṣiptamukhiyenāgi
va॥adalladeyuṁ

va॥mattamātaṁ kaikoṇḍudaṟiṁ r̥ṣivēṣakkagrāmyateyuṁ ātanaṁ
pordida javvanakke saundaryamuṁ ātana kivigavataṁsamāda pārijātakusuma
mañjarige manōharateyumātaniravindame suralōkakke ramaṇīyateyu
mātana rūpasampattiyiṁ kusumāyudhaṅge durjayatvamumādudendu bage
yuttamā saubhāgyanidhiya viyōgadiṁ jīvaviyōgamāgadirkendu taguḷcida

rakṣātnāvaḷiyante koraloḷikkirdakṣāratnāvaḷiyuṁ ātana rahasyālāpadante kivigevanvendu
rājisuva pārijātakusumamañjariyumātana karatalasparśasukhadiṁ kapōla
tala kadambamukuḷakarṇapūradantuṇmirda puḷakamuṁ berasu gadgadacittetrayenē
kākiyāgirpudumannegavenna tāmbūlakaraṅkavāhini makarikeyembaḷ peṟaṟige
kiṟidu bēgaṁ mīyalendu nindanantaraṁ mattatsamīkke bandu mellanintendaḷ
va॥adentene

va॥adentendoḍe dinakaramarīciyindādapsarasiyoḷudisida gaurigaṁ
gandharvalōkādhipatiyappa haṁsaṅgaṁ magaḷāgi mahāśvēteyemba pesariṁ
negaḻteḻttavettaḷadalladeyuṁ indu jananiyoḍanī sarōvaramaṁmuṁ mīyalendu
bandātmanivāsamappa hēmakūṭācalakke pōguttirdapaḷembuduṁ kiṟidu
bēgamēnānuṁnumaṁ tannoḷe bageyuttettamirdanantaramenna nintendaṁ
va॥endu nuḍiyalānāgaḷādaramberasu kaigaḷaṁ mugidu

lg.l: nnu sirvurpudu nanniyaṁ nuḍiye kāryavanennavaḷīkeyendu bhā

va॥anantaraṁ
va॥anantaramā lēkhanamaṁ kaḷedukoṇḍu nimirci nōḻpannegamalli
va॥embī āryeyaṁ bhāvisi nōḍe

va॥antu nōḍi piridumuṭṭiḻkiṟiṁ kelakke karedu kuḷḷirisi
va॥antādarisutamirdu
va॥endu
va॥annegaṁ
va॥āgaḷeḷinna koḍeviḍidavaḷ bāgiliṁ paritandu
va॥endavaḷ bandu pēḻvuduṁ

va॥āgaḷorva kañcukiyaṁ karedu bēgavoḍagoṇḍu bāyendu
pēḻaḻiloḍane

va॥antu rūpiṅge yavvanamuṁ yavvanakke kāmanuṁ kāmaṅge vasanta
samayamuṁ vasantasamayakke tambelarumembante puṇḍarīkaṅge sahāyanappa
munikumāranaṁ kaṇḍenannegaṁ munipaṁ vyākulanante śūnyanante duḥkhita
nāgirdantēnānuṁ prārthipanante barutirdanirpuduṁ tatkṣatṣaṇadoḷ

va॥āgaḷaṟidivaḷiḷenna śarīradiṁ bēṟillaḷ muniśaṅkarā nīṁ besasi
membuduṁ
va॥adalladeyuṁ

lg.l: bagevoḍe kaṭṭidī jaḍege takkudo mēṇ podedirda nārasī

div.p: va॥ādoḍaṁ
va॥adentene

va॥annegaṁ nīvuṁ nijanivāsakkevandirāgaḷānēkākiyāgirdu
mēgeyyuttirdapanendu kutūhalamberasu munnineḍege bandunōḍi kāṇade
vyagramananāgi

lg.l: ḍeraḷivolāgi pōdano bhayamberasenna mogakke nāṇcisāṇce me

div.p: va॥endu vikalpisuttamirdu

va॥endaṟisi nōḍuttamententu kāṇadirpenantantēnumaṁ mana
doḷ bhāvisuttamirdu

va॥antu nōḍutirpannegamondu sarassamīpadoḷ vananirantarateyiṁ
kusumamayamuṁ parabhr̥tamayamuṁ mayūramayamumāgi vasantajanma
bhūmiyumādantiralatimanōharamāda latāgahanadoḷutsr̥ṣṭasakalavyāpāra
nuṁ vigatanimēṣanumenisi baredananteyuṁ kaṇḍarisidananteyuṁ maṟavaṭṭanante
yuṁ yōgasamādhisthitananteyumuparatavaśanādanteyumirdanalladeyuṁ
va॥aādalladeyuṁ

va॥aādalladeyuṁ madanavaśīkaraṇacūrṇadante mēle kedaṟuva
kusumarēṇugaḷuṁ ātmarāgamaṁmuṁ saṅkramisuvante mēlaleva raktāśōka
pallavamuṁ vanalakṣmiyoḍarcuva ratābhiṣēkadante suriva puṣpastabakaśīkaraṅgaḷuṁ
atibahuḷavanāmōdamattamadhukarajhuṅrjhuṅkāraṅgaḷoḷ poreda dakṣiṇānilanuṁ
vasantajayaśabdakōlāhalaṅgaḷante kaḷakaḷipa kōgilegaḷumatyāku la te yaṁ
māḍe janmāntarōpagatanādanteyuṁ rūpāntaramaṁmuṁ kaikoṇḍateyuṁ
manmathāvēgadindaṟiyalke bāradākāramaṁ bhāvisi nōḍi
va॥adalladeyuṁ
va॥endātanirpa latāmaṇṭapadoḷagaṇa candrakāntaśilātaḷakke bandu

va॥antu besagoḷvudumāgaḷeḍeviḍade mucci beccantirda kaṇgaḷa
nentānuṁ teṟedu
va॥antu kiṟidubēgamennaṁ bhāvisi nōḍi
va॥embudumadu nīnendante niścayamappudādoḍaṁ
va॥adalladeyuṁ

va॥adalladeyumatibahuḷarajadoḷ poreda ponalgaḷantunmārgadiṁ
parivindriyaṅgaḷaṁ nivārisadeyuṁ kadaḍida manamaṁ niyāmisadeyuṁ inti
ppurduducitamallamanaṅganemba durācāranaṁ nivartisalvēḻkumembudavākṣēpaṁ
geydemeduṟugaliniḻīḻiva tōrakaṇbanigaḷaṁ basiyuttamenna nintendaṁ

va॥adentendoḍe kalpāntōditadvādaśadinakarakiraṇātapa tīvramappa
madanasantāpakkupaśamanōpāyamanāṁ prāṇamberasenitubēgamirpenannevara
mapēkṣisadappenalladeyuṁ

lg.l: ppoḍe dal māṇipudembidaṁ nuḍidu mātaṁ māṇdanabjānanē

div.p: va॥antusiradire mattamānātanaṁ sambōdhisalendu

va॥antu meyyaṟiyadirdanaṁ kaṇḍu bhayaṅgoṇḍupadēśakkeḍe
yillade prāṇarakṣaṇōpāyamanādoḍaṁ māḻpenendallindameḻdacchōda
sarōvaramaṁ pokku sarasamr̥ṇāḷa nāḷaṅgaḷumaṁ jalalavalāñchitaṅgaḷappa naḷi
nīdaḷaṅgaḷumaṁ parāgaparimaḷamanōharaṅgaḷappa kumudakuvalayaṅgaḷumaṁ
tandā latāmandiradoḷagaṇa candrakāntaśilātalaṅgaḷoḷ palavumanalpa
talpaṅgaḷumaṁ māḻpudumātanallige meyyanīḍāḍi keladoḷirda candanapallava
deḷadaḷirgaḷaṁ karataḷadiṁ piḻidu nisargaparimaḷamaṁ taḷeda haimadante kuḷi

korīrṇīḍuva tadrasadiṁ lalāṭaṁmodalāgi caraṇataḷambaraṁ aṅgacarciyaneḍe
viḍadoḍarciyuṁ abhyarṇapādapasphuṭita valkalaṅgaḷoḷaṁ kaṭṭida karpūra
rajada poṭṭaṇaṅgaḷoḷaṁ svēdapratīkāramananavarataṁ māḍiyuṁ tiḷinīra
tunturvanigaḷiṁ poredeḷavāḻiya suḻiya bijjaṇigegaḷinaḍigaḍige bīsiyuṁ
mattamanēka śiśirōpacāraṅgaḷaṁ māḍiyumavellanuṁmuṁ puṇḍarīkaṅguddīpa
piṇḍadante kēvalaṁ santāpanuṁmuṁ māḻpudumennoḷintendeṁ

lg.l: janakaṁ gandharvarājaṁ tanagenisida vikhyātiyuṁ tāḻdiḷdi kāntā
janaratnaṁ tānenal sandati cature mahāśvēte tānettatradenduṁ
binitaṁ tāṁ nōḍadēṁ māḍidano virahasantāpanuṁmuṁ puṣpacāpaṁ

div.p:
va॥antu duryaśaḥpadamuṁ duṣkaramuṁ dussādhyamuṁ durghaṭa
mumenipeḍeyoḷirdegeṭṭadondavajñeyindesagidapaṁ viṣamāstranadu kāraṇadiṁ
va॥antu cintisuttamirdumennoḷintendeṁ

lg.l: kṣisavēḻkuṁ bēgamāṁ rakṣisuva teṟanumentendoḍaṁ niścayaṁ bhā

div.p:
va॥adaṟindinnākeyalligentādoḍaṁ pōgītanavasthātaramuṁ pēḻa
lvēḍidappudendu mattaṁ

lg.l: du nevaṁ māḍi mahōtkaṭatvade diṭaṁ bandeṁ cakōrēkṣaṇē
kkudanāṁ bandeḍegaṁ mr̥gākṣi ninagaṁ pōlvantuṭaṁ nīne ba
hadamevellaṁ neṟe bandu kūḍitu gaḍembantānumūmādeṁ nr̥pā

div.p:
va॥antatīndriyasaukhyaparamakōṭiyaneydi nāṇeṟakadindinitu
bēgaṁ taleyuṁ bāgiralemeyaṁ kapōlatalamanuṁmuṁ muṭṭadondaṟi pindonda
ḍasi guḍuguḍane surivānandajalabindugaḷenna niratiśaya harṣamaṁ prakaṭisuttira
lennoḷintendeṁ

lg.l: enagentantire daivadiṁ priyanoḷaṁ santāpanuṁmuṁ māḍi ta
tane muṁ tāninitanumontāginitondavasthegoḷagāgal kāmanaṁ biṭṭu ma

div.p:
va॥āgaḷorvaḷatisambhramamberasu dauvārike bandu poḍavamaṭṭu rāja
putri nīnasvasthaśarīriṇiyāgirdudaṁ parijanadiṁ kēḷdu mahādēviyar ninnallige
bijayaṅgeyduydaparembudaṁ kapiñjalaṁ kēḷdu neravi kavitarpudendañji bēganeḻdu

va॥endu nuḍidu maṟumātuguḍalavasaramilladire madīyāmbikeya
munde paritarpa dauvārikeyariṁ sahavāsigaḷaṁḷiṁ cāmaradaḍapada kannaḍiya pari
cārikeyariṁ kūḍe sandaṇisida bāgiloḷanḷintānuṁ nusuḷdu pōdanannegamittatral

lg.l: tānuṁ poḻtirdu manege pōdaḷ gaḍa tā

div.p:
va॥annegamittalambhōjinījīvitēśvaranastaṅgatanappuduṁ pātāḷa
paṅkakaluṣita mahāpraḷayajaḷadhigaḷ mēredappi kavidu bhuvanaṅgaḷellamanoḷa
kayyalukkiduvembantiḍidaḍaregoṇḍu kattaṭtale kaviye kiṅkartavyatāmūḍheye
nāgi taraḷikeyanintendeṁ

va॥endu tānitarakanyakeyante nāṇgeṭṭu svairaṇeyaṁ biṭṭu vinaya
manokku janāpavādamuṁmaṁ mikku nijācāramuṁmaṁ maṟedu śīlamuṁmaṁ toṟedu
kulakramamuṁmaṁ pālisade rāgāndheyanāgi
va॥endu nuḍivuttamirpannegaṁ
va॥tadanantaraṁ

va॥antabhinavōdayarāgarañjitanappa rajanikaranaṁ nōḍaloḍamatyu
jjvajvalamadanānalajvālākalāpeyāgiyumandhakārahr̥dayeyenennoḷanḷintendeṁ

va॥āgaḷatisambhramamberasu taraḷike tanda candanada carcegaḷiṁ matta
manēkaśirōpacāraṅgaḷindupacarisaladaṟinentānuṁ mūrcheyindeccettu
va॥antu nōḷpuḍpuduṁ candanapaṅkādraṅrdraṅgaḷappa karakamalaṅgaḷaṁ mugidu

lg.l: nnenitaṁ nōḍutamirpe nīnakaruṇaṁ mēṇ pōgu nīnendu pēḻ

div.p: va॥endu taraḷike nuḍiye

lg.l: idanēnendappe nāṇēṁ gurugaḷumenaginnēke pēḻ mr̥tyugaḷkūḍidanalteñcandranettāvōl mū
ḍidanaltē candranuṁ tānirade karuṇadindoyvoḍēḻ pōpamī dē

div.p: va॥antēḻaloḍane

lg.l: ṇmidudō pēḻeḻine lōkadoḷ kavidu parvittandu candrātapaṁ

div.p:
va॥antu parvida beḷdiṅgaḷoḷakhiḷajanamellaṁ śvētadvīpadoḷirdanti
ralā rātriyoḷ madanavihvalateyiṁ mūrchevōdennaneccaṟisalendu nosa
loḷikkidamanmundavappa candanadaṇpuṇpiniṁ patti pagiltu beḷkarisidaḷakanikaramuṁ
munname koraḷoḷikkirdakṣāktāvaḷiyuṁ kiviyoḷikkirda pārijātakusuma
mañjariyuṁ padmarāgamaṇikiraṇadantirda raktāṁśukamumennoḷaḷavaḍe gr̥hīta
vividhakusumatāmbūlarāśiyumamuppa taraḷikeverasu madīya paricitaparijanamu
maṟiṟeyadantu karumāvāḍadindavanitaḷakkavatarisi

va॥antu taraḷikeverasu pramadavanapakṣadvāradiṁ poṟamaṭṭu pōguttuṁ
parijanavirahiteyenennoḷanḷintendeṁ

pariye niśākaraṁ nijakarōtkaradiṁ piḍidoyye bēṟe pēḻ

div.p: va॥endennoḷ cintisuttaṁ taraḷikeyunintendeṁ
va॥embuduṁ taraḷike muguḷnage naguttamennanintendaḷ
va॥adentendoḍe

div.p:
va॥adalladeyuṁ virahavihvalateyiṁ candanānuliptanādante beḷarpi
nāvarisiyuṁ mātoḷarḷapa nevadiṁ paḷukina pāsaregaḷoḷ meyyanīḍā
ḍiyuṁ neydilgoḷaṅgaḷoḷōlāḍiyumosarva candrakāntaśilātalaṅgaḷoḷ
karaṅgaḷaneḷaviyuṁ vighaṭitacakravākaṅgaḷappa kamalavanaṅgaḷoḷ pāyduvintu
palateṟade kōṭalegoḷutirdapanintivu modalāgi tatkālōcitavacanaṅgaḷaṁ
nuḍiyuttamiralākeneverasā pradēśamaneydivarpāgaḷ
va॥adentendoḍe

lg.l: urideṁ bendenidēnanintu negaḻdai nistriṁśa puṣpāstra ni
ṣṭhura pēḻ polladanēnanācarisidaḷ ninnoḷ mahāśvēte bhī
kara dōṣākara kūḍitē bageduduṁ caṇḍāḷa taṅgāḷi pēḻ
pusimuḷisēke pēḻ keḷeya ninnaya kūrmeyadattavōpōytu nō
adanāṁ kēnāṅkeḷderdegeṭṭu meymaṟugi sattantāgi kaṇṇīra pū

va॥adalladeyuṁ

va॥mattamanaṅgaracitacandanalalāṭikātripuṇḍranuṁ sarasabisasūtra
yajñōpavītanuṁ aṁsāvasaktabālakadaḷīdaḷōttarīriyanuṁ ēkāvaḷīviśā
lākṣamālanuṁ ānuṁaviraḷakarpūraparāgabhasmapāṇḍuranuṁ ābaddhamr̥ṇāḷarakṣā
pratisaranumāgi manōbhavavratavēṣamaṁ kaikoṇḍu matsamānūgamumamantramaṁ
sādhipantirdanantumalladeyuṁ

biḻdu pātāḷatalavivaramaṁmuṁ pokkante mahāndhakāraṁ kaviye

lg.l: palavu bhavanaṅgaḷoḷ nerapidennaya pāpavomo mēregeṭṭa kō

va॥ānantenna sāvilladudamūtanasāvunudavaḻalanodavise bāyaḻidu
meyyaṟiyadavaḷeṁ

div.p:
va॥endu māṇade mattamīvītananettamēvēḻkumendu kapiñjalamahā
muniyaḍiyoḷaḍigaḍige poraḷdumadavaḻalodave taraḷikeyanappi palateṟade paḻa
visi palumbi pambalisiyuṁ ā manōharana mandaisi ninda candanadaṇbeṇbiniṁ
pagiltu patti beḷkarisi rañjisuva keñjaḍeya modaliṁ beḍaṅguvaḍedu miṟupa
peṟenosaloḷaṁ kaviva jaḍeyatoṅgaliṁ saṅgaḷisi beḍaṅganoḷakoṇḍa gaṇḍa
maṇḍalaṅgaḷoḷaṁ kōmalamr̥ṇāḷōttaṁsitaṅgaḷappaṁsadēśaṅgaḷoḷaṁ malaya
jarasaluḷita naḷinīdaḷāvakuṇṭhitadaḷaṅgaḷoḷandiniḷeyuvāmāda mellerdeyoḷanōmōrorme kaḷavaḷisi
karataḷadineḷaviyuṁ puṇḍarīkana pakkadiṁ teraḷadeyuṁ niṣkaruṇiyādeyendō
rōrme sambhramadinupālambhanaṁ māḍiyuṁ koralaṁ taḻkaisiyuṁ biḍadaḷa
villadeḍedeyuḍugadaḻtumendumanupadiṣṭaṅgaḷumadr̥ṣṭapūrvaṅgaḷumatikr̥paṇaṁ
gaḷumappa cāṭusahasraṅgaḷodave kaṇṇīrapūradiṁ tēṅkāḍuttanuśrupravāha
janmabhūmiyuṁ pralāpaśikharasahasrasambhūteyuṁ dussahaduḥkhaprasūteyu
mādenendātmīya vr̥ttāntamanātaṅge nivēdisuttamirpuduṁ
va॥antu mūrchevōgi bīḻduduṁ
va॥antu bīsi mūrcheyindeccaṟisi

lg.l: nenedoḍamante kēḷdoḍe navadaḍemunde kēḷda bhavavyatheyuṁ neṟe māḍadirkumē

miḍivuttaṁ mattamintendaḷ

div.p:
va॥adentendoḍe taraḷatarahārālaṅkr̥tanuṁ viśālavakṣasthalanuṁ
kēyūrakōṭilagna pavanataraḷataradhavaḷōttarīyāṁśukanuṁ kāminīkuca
kuṅkumapatralatālāñchitāṁsa dēśanu mubhaya karṇāndōḷita makarakuṇḍala
maṇiprabhāraktagaṇḍamaṇḍalanuṁ aḷikulanīlakuṭilakuntaḷa vikaṭavaumauḷiyuṁ
utphullakumudakr̥takarṇapūranuṁ dukūlapallavakalpitōṣṇīṣanuṁ kumuda
dhavaḷadēhanuṁ mahāpramāṇapuruṣanuṁ mahāpuruṣalakṣaṇōpētanuṁ divyā
kāranumenisida mahānubhāvaṁ

va॥antatiśītalasparśaṅgaḷappa mr̥ṇālakōmalaṅgaḷenipa karāṅguḷi
gaḷinenna munduparatanāda puṇḍarīkananettikoṇḍu

kapiñjalana pōgiṅge śōkavirmuḍiyāge kiṅkartavyatāmūḍheyenāgi
va॥endavaḷ kālamēle bīḻvuduṁ

lg.l: sarisade nanna nāne biḍalāṟada pātakiyaṁ mahīpatī

div.p:
va॥anantaramā sarōvarada tīradoḷiḷeḍeviḍade poraḷutave pareda muḍi
yoḷ poredu kaṇṇanīriṁ nāndu kadampinoḷ pagiltu pattiduttarīyeyeṁ
ākrandanadiṁ gaṇṭaloḍedu dani kiḍe taraḷikeverasu biḍadaḻuttamiralā pāpa

kāriṇiyappa kāḷarātripratimeyenisida mahārātriyāgal śōkōdrēkadiṁ

va॥antu pōge

vismayākṣiptacittanintendaṁ
va॥ādentadentene

div.head: kādambariya prathama sandarśana
div.p:
va॥ānantaraṁ śaiśavamaṁ pattuviṭṭeṭṭapurdumā kādambarīdēviyuṁ
madīya hatavr̥ttāttamuṁttāntamaṁ kēḷdatyantaśōkākrānteyāgi

va॥antupārūḍhayuvvaneyappa magaḷa niścayamaṁ madirāmahādē
viyumarasucitrarathanuṁ karṇaparampareyiṁ parijanadattaṇiṁ kēḷdu piriduma
ḻildu kṣīrōdanemba kañcukiyaṁ karedennalligaṭṭidoḍātaṁ bandu
va॥endu jananījanakaraṭṭidarendu nuḍiye

va॥endu pēḻdaḷannegamitta lāñchanacchaladiṁ śōkānaladagdhamappa
mahāśvētāhr̥dayamaṁ viḍambisuvanteyuṁ munikumāravadhamahāpāta
kamaṁ tāḷdidanteyumāgi

va॥antu nikhilalōkanidrāmaṅgalakalaśadante kumudinībhāndhavaṁ
gaganāṅgaṇadoḷeseye supteyāda mahāśvēteyaṁ nōḍi candrāpīḍaṁ
pallavaśayanataladoḷ meyyanikki bīḍaṁ nenedu

va॥antu cintisutirdiraḷuṁ kaḷeḷidu beḷagappuduṁ kr̥taprābhātika
niyamanāge mahāśvēteyumaghamarṣaṇa niyama japaṅgaḷaṁ māḍutirdaḷanne
gamitta ṣōḍaśavarṣa vayaskanuṁ udāttākāranuṁ vibhaktamadhyākāranuṁ
vimala vakṣasthalanuṁ dīrghāyatabāhuyugaḷanuṁ paryuṣita candanāṅgarāga
dhūsarōrudaṇḍanuṁ kuṅkumāṅgarāgapiñjara rūpanuṁ cāmīkaraśr̥ṅkhalā
kalāpanuṁ nibiḍaniyamita kakṣabandhātiriktaprēṅkhaddukūlapallavanuṁ vāma
prakōṣṭhaḍōlāyamānamāṇikyavalayanuṁ karṇābharaṇavikīryamāṇa
kiraṇēndracāpaprabhājālanuṁ anavaratatāmbūlabaddharāgānukāri bandhurādha
ranuṁ dīrghadhavaḷalōcananuṁ kanakapaṭṭagrathita pr̥thulalalāṭapaṭṭanumaḷi
kulanīlakuṭilakuntaḷanuṁ agrāmyākr̥tiyuṁ rājakulasēvanāticaturanu
mappa kēyūranemba gandharvakumāramberasu taraḷike mahāśvēteyallige bandī
rvaruṁ dūrāvanatōttamāṅgarāgi poḍamaṭṭu kuḷḷirdu

va॥āgaḷ mahāśvēteyuṁ nirvartitānusmiteyāgi taraḷikeya
mogamaṁ nōḍi
va॥embudumātanaṁ besagoḷe

lg.l: manamuṁmaṁ nōḍalidēke tannamma manamuṁmaṁ tāṁ nōḍalēnāṁ tapō

div.p:
va॥endivu modalāgi kādambari nuḍida nuḍigaḷaṁ kēyūrakaṁ binna
visaladaṁ kēḷdu tannoḷe tāne bhāvisi
va॥antātaṁ pōge candrāpīḍananintendaḷ

lg.l: ide sārirpudu rājadhāni piriduṁ citrāvahaṁ bandu nō

div.p:
va॥adalladeyuṁ madīya prārthaneyaṁ nirarthakaṁmāḍadindu
bandalli viśramisi nāḷe bīḍiṅge bijayaṅgeyvudendu mattamintendaḷ
va॥endu nuḍidoḍe

va॥antu baruttaṁ hēmakūṭamaneydi vicitramenisidacitraratharāja
dhāniyaṁ pokku saptakakṣyāntaragaḷa kāñcanamaya tōraṇaṅgaḷaṁ nusuḷdu
kanyāntaḥpuradvāramaneydi varpāgapārgaḷ

va॥āgaḷarasanuṁ pranuntratīhārikā janōpadiśyamānamārganāgi pokku
nōḻpannegamalli

va॥antu vadanadyutiyinindubimbavr̥ṣṭisurivanteyuṁ ayuṁāpāṅgavikṣēpaṁ
gaḷiṁ kuvalayavanavikāsamādanteyuṁ kapōlatalaṅgaḷa beḷagugaḷiṁ maṇi
darpaṇaṅgaḷ poḷevanteyuṁ bhrūlatāvibhramaṅgaḷiṁ kāmamukārmukavisaraṁ
pasarisidanteyuṁ kēśakalāpāndhakāradiṁ kāriruḷ kavidanteyuṁ surabhi
niśvāsaṅgaḷiṁ malayamārutaṁ tīḍidanteyuṁ muguḷnageya beḷagugaḷiṁ
vasantasamaya mādanteyuṁ karatalarāgadiṁ kendāvaregaḷalardanteyuṁ kararuha
kiraṇaṅgaḷiṁ kusumāyudhaśaraśataṅgaḷ surivanteyumādudantumalladeyuṁ

lg.l: kaḍegaṇ karṇāvataṁsaṁ karatalaruci līlāravindaṁ kucaṁ ka
nnaḍi pādāmbhōjarāgaṁ misupalatege mandasmitaṁ candanaṁ me
calatege kāraṇaṁ kusumamālikeyuṁ poṟe puṣpadāma mē
khale naḍegaḍḍi kaṇmalarge kāḍige biṇṇiṇṇatu pādasaṅpaṅkaja

div.p:
va॥mattamattitta pugutarpalli lavalikeyaṁ kētakīdhūḷiyoḷāla
vālamaṁ sameyaluṁ sāgarikeyaṁ gandhōdakakanakadīrghikegaḷoḷ rannada
maḷalgaḷaṁ suriyaluṁ mr̥ṇāḷikeyaṁ kr̥trimakamaliniyoḷāḍuva jakkavakkigaḷa
mēle kuṅkumarajamaṁ kedaṟaluṁ makarikeyaṁ gandhapātraṅgaḷoḷ karpūra
rasamūḍi vāsisaluṁ rajanikeyaṁ tamālavīdhiyanamadarkattardakatraleyoḷ māṇi
kada soḍargaḷaṁ beḷagaluṁ kumudikeyaṁ giḷi pāyadantu dāḍivīmī phalaṅgaḷa
mēle muttina jhumjhampāḷaṅgaḷaṁ kaviyaluṁ nipuṇikeyaṁ maṇistambhaṅgaḷoḷ
rañjisuva sālabhañjikeya kucaṅgaḷoḷ kuṅkumarasadiṁ patrabhaṅgaṅgaḷaṁ citri
saluṁ utpalikeyaṁ kadaḷīgr̥hamarakatavēdiyuṁyaṁ kamaladaḷaṅgaḷiṁ toḍeyaluṁ
kēsarikeyaṁ vakuḷakusumamālāmaṇṭapaṅgaḷaṁ madirārasadiṁ simpisaluṁ
mālatikeyaṁ kāmadēvagr̥hadōlagaśāleyaṁ sindhūra rēṇugaḷiṁ beḷargempaṁ
māḍaluṁ naḷinikeyaṁ bhavanakalahaṁsaṅgaḷge kamalamadhurasavaneṟeyaluṁ kadaḷi
keyaṁ dhārāgr̥hakke gr̥hamayūraṅgaḷanoyyaluṁ kamaliniyaṁ jakkavakkigaḷaṁ
mr̥ṇāḷa kṣīrarasamaṁ kuḍiyisaluṁ cūtalatikeyaṁ pañjarada gaṇḍu kōgile
gaḷge cūtāṅkurada kuṭukanikkaluṁ pallavikeyaṁ bhavana hariṇaṅgaḷge marīca
pallavadaḷaṅgaḷaṁ nīḍaluṁ lavaṅgikeyaṁ cakōrapañjaraṅgaḷoḷ pippalītaṇḍu
laṅgaḷa kuṭukaṁ sūsaluṁ madhukarikeyaṁ pūdoḍigeyaṁ māḍaluṁ mayūri
keyaṁ kinnara mithunaṅgaḷaṁ saṅgītaśālege kaḷupaluṁ kandaḷikeyaṁ jīvañjīvaka
mithunaṅgaḷaṁ krīḍāparvatamanēṟisaluṁ hariṇikeyaṁ śukasārikegaḷanōdi
saluṁ pesirvesaroḷi kaḷkaredu pēḻpaḻva manōharālāpaṅgaḷaṁ kēḷuttaṁ pōgevōge

lg.l: goḷe nuḍidēke pēḻ nagisuvay vacanāñcalamendu mauktikā

div.p:
va॥endivu modalāgi parihāsajalpitaṅgaḷaṁ kēḷuttampōgalupavana
lategaḷindudirdalara dhūḷiyiṁ puḻilgaṭṭidanteyuṁ kōgilegaḷeḍeviḍadugura
moneyoḷaḷḷiṟiḷpiḻiye suriva sahakāraphalarasada sōnegaḷiṁ durdinaṁ masagidante
yuṁ vakuḷada maraṅgaḷelaralepadiṁ kedaṟida sīdhudhārāprasaradiṁ tuntu
rmasagidanteyuṁ pūvaligedarda sampageyesaḷaprasaradiṁ suvarṇadvīpadante
yuṁ eḍeyāḍuveḷaveṇḍira mellaḍigaḷalategegaḷiṁ rāgasāgaraṅkavidanteyuṁ
aṅgarāgāmōdaṅgaḷiṁ pārijātajanmadinadanteyuṁ toḷaguva muttina toḍa
vugaḷa beḷagugaḷiṁ beḷdiṅgaḷādanteyuṁ kr̥ṣṇāgarupatrabhaṅgaṅgaḷiṁ nīlāya
mānamuṁ karṇapūrāśōkapallavaṅgaḷiṁ lōhitāyamānamuṁ candanalē
paṅgaḷiṁ dhavaḷāyamānamuṁ śirīṣakusumābharaṇaṅgaḷiṁ haritāyamānamu
mappamārgamaṁ nōḍute barpannegamalli

va॥ā maṇimaya maṇṭapamadhyabhāgadoḷanēka kanyakāparijanavr̥te
yāgi

lg.l: ḍaḷadoḷ beḷpiḷpaisedirda kauḷuḍeyanondaṁ nemmi kuḷḷirda kō
daradoḷe tammanna tammanna niḷayakkiradoydu paroldu kanneyaṁ

div.p:
va॥mattameḍeyāḍuveḷaveṇḍira nūpurada.nuṇbaṇcarakkeḷasi pariva vallabha
haṁsanaṁ mr̥ṇāḷalateya saṅkoleyoḷikkendu haṁsapālikeyaṁ besasuttamā
bharaṇadoḷagurcida pacceya pasarisida pasuraṁ pasurelegetteḷasuva vallabhahariṇa
śābakaṅgaḷge keḷadiyara kayyallirda yuyavāṅkuragaḷaṁ nīḍuttaṁ dēvi nīṁ naḍe
pideḷalate nanedōṟitendu binnavisida bālakiyaranābharaṇapradānātisanmānaṁ
gaḷaṁḷiṁ santōṣambaḍisutirdaḷantumalladeyuṁ

va॥mattaṁ mahāśvēteyattaṇiṁ banda nr̥parūpacandramana rūpātiśaya
guṇaṅgaḷaṁ binnavisutirda kēyūrakana mogamaṁ nōḍi

va॥endu maguḻimaguḻi besagoḷutirda gandharvarājanandaneya
natidūradoḷ vismitāntaraṅganāgi nōḍi
